entries.reason: Single Responsibility — The draft stays focused on one concern: recording and exposing per-phase AI active duration.; Unambiguous Requirements — Requirements specify measurable behavior (e.g., `durationMs` accumulation, `12.3s` format, command output changes).; Complete Context — Each requirement includes an implicit/explicit trigger and expected outcome (spawn, accumulate call, report/token execution).; No Hardcoded Secrets — No API keys, tokens, passwords, or secret-like literals appear in the draft.; Prioritize Requirements — There are four requirements (R1–R4) but no priority order is defined.; Impact on Existing Features — The draft has an explicit impact section covering signature, schema, and output changes.; Present Recommendations with Reasoning — Some Q&A entries present options or confirmations without a clear recommended answer plus explicit basis.; Explore Before Asking — The draft shows prior context gathering from Issue #171 and existing modules before decision questions.; Proactively Raise Related Implications — It proactively calls out out-of-scope timing, output impact, and future extensibility implications.; Confirm Brainstorm vs. Decision Before Critiquing — In Q2, critique/recommendation is given without explicitly confirming brainstorming vs final decision mode first.; Capture Digressions in draft.md — The phase wall-clock digression is captured in Out of Scope and Q&A before returning to core scope.; Draft Stays at Requirements Level — It includes implementation-level details (specific file paths, function names, and signature changes).; Backward — Compatible CLI Interface — No command/option removal or semantic break is proposed; migration plan is not required.

Single Responsibility — 目的は「phaseごとのAI稼働時間計測と可視化」に一貫しており、関連変更に限定されている。; Unambiguous Requirements — 計測対象、単位（ms/秒小数1桁）、対象外条件、表示形式が検証可能な形で明記されている。; Complete Context — 要件は「shall相当の期待動作」はあるが、各項目で明示的な When/If 条件との対が不足している。; No Hardcoded Secrets — 仕様文書であり、APIキー等の秘密情報の直書きは含まれていない。; Prioritize Requirements — 4件の要件に R1〜R4 の優先度（critical/high/medium）が明示されている。; Impact on Existing Features — 既存メトリクス構造と2コマンド出力への影響が具体的に列挙されている。; Present Recommendations with Reasoning — 各Qで推奨を先頭提示し、Issue本文・ガードレール・既存コードの根拠を添えている。; Explore Before Asking — 既存コード（`runWithLogging`）や既存テスト配置への言及があり、探索に基づく判断になっている。; Proactively Raise Related Implications — Out of Scope・Future Extensibility・影響範囲で関連含意を先回りして明示している。; Confirm Brainstorm vs. Decision Before Critiquing — Q2で brainstorm モード確認を明記した上で評価・推奨している。; Capture Digressions in draft.md — 脱線論点（phase start/end計測）をQ&Aとしてドラフト内に記録している。; Draft Stays at Requirements Level — 「内部関数シグネチャ変更」や特定関数名への言及があり、要件レベルを超える実装詳細が混在している。; Backward — Compatible CLI Interface — `flow report`/`metrics token` 出力変更に対するCLI利用者向け移行方針（互換モード・告知・切替手順）が記載されていない。

Single Responsibility — The draft stays focused on one concern: accumulating and reporting per-phase AI active duration.; Unambiguous Requirements — Requirements specify measurable conditions (ms accumulation, one-decimal-second display, explicit command outputs).; Complete Context — Each requirement includes trigger context (`When/If`) and expected behavior (`shall`).; No Hardcoded Secrets — No API keys, tokens, passwords, or similar secrets appear in the draft content.; Prioritize Requirements — More than three requirements are present and explicitly prioritized (R1–R4 with critical/high/medium).; Impact on Existing Features — Impact is explicitly documented for metrics schema and command output changes.; Present Recommendations with Reasoning — Each Q&A includes a concise recommendation with stated basis (issue text, guardrails, or code patterns).; Explore Before Asking — The draft cites existing issue text and code/test patterns, showing prior exploration before user confirmation questions.; Proactively Raise Related Implications — It proactively covers compatibility, migration expectations, alternatives, and future extensibility implications.; Confirm Brainstorm vs. Decision Before Critiquing — The draft explicitly confirms brainstorm mode in Q2 before giving evaluative guidance.; Capture Digressions in draft.md — The phase-wall-clock digression is captured in the draft’s Q&A and resolved before returning to scope.; Draft Stays at Requirements Level — It includes implementation-level detail (e.g., specific `runWithLogging` retry behavior and concrete test-layer placement).; Backward — Compatible CLI Interface — CLI contract impact is addressed with an explicit compatibility/migration note (no command/option/exit-code changes).
line 92: unchecked task/question (- [ ] なし（draft フェーズで全論点を解決済み）。)

R1 AI呼び出しでspawn開始から終了までをms計測し、retry分も含めてphaseへ累積する — `agent.js`で`startedAt`からの経過msを`durationMs`として渡し、retry合算を検証するテストも通過している。; R2 メトリクス永続化層でphase付き呼び出しのdurationMsを加算し、phaseなしはスキップする — `flow-store.js`で`phase`未指定時に早期returnし、`durationMs`を既存メトリクスへ加算している。; R3 flow reportのtext出力でphaseごとのduration秒表示を行う — 追加実装は集計トータル`tokenMetrics.durationMs`の1行表示で、phase別のduration表示は確認できない。; R4 metrics token出力にphaseごとのduration列（秒小数1桁）を追加する — `metrics/commands/token.js`で`duration`列と`x.xs`表示を追加し、関連テストが通過している。

Measure agent invocation elapsed time per active phase (including retries) and accumulate in ms — `agent.js` computes `durationMs` from invocation start to completion and passes it to metric accumulation; retry-inclusive behavior is covered by spec-191 R1 tests.; Persist duration into phase metrics only when phase context exists — `flow-store.accumulateAgentMetrics` adds `durationMs` to `metrics.<phase>.durationMs` when provided and no-ops when phase is null, matching existing phase-gated behavior.; Show per — phase duration in flow report text as seconds with one decimal — `flow/commands/report.js` aggregates `durationMs` and renders total and phase lines using `(durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1) + "s"`.; Add duration column to metrics token output with same seconds format — `metrics/commands/token.js` adds `durationMs` to rows/CSV and prints a `duration` text column formatted as `X.Ys`; spec-191 R4 tests pass.; No Hardcoded Secrets — No API keys, passwords, tokens, or other secrets are introduced in the provided changes.; No Silent Error Swallowing — Added error handling writes failures to `stderr`; no empty catch blocks are introduced.; Bounded Resource Usage — Changes add simple per-phase iteration and metric accumulation only; no new unbounded recursion/retry/bulk-loading behavior is introduced.; No Sensitive Data in Logs — New logging only emits metric accumulation error messages, not credentials or PII.; No Disabling Existing Tests — Existing tests are not skipped/commented out/deleted; new assertions are added.; Escalate When New Tests Break Existing Tests — Inapplicable in this diff because no test-break incident/response workflow is shown.; Do Not Modify Existing Tests Without Approval — Existing test files were modified, and the provided content contains no explicit user approval for those modifications.; Flag Tests That Become Irrelevant — Inapplicable here because no tests are shown as obsolete or intentionally deprecated by the feature change.; Exit Code Contract — No production command behavior is changed to return success on failure; exit code contract remains unchanged.; No Synchronous I/O in Hot Paths — No synchronous file I/O is introduced in loops or bulk-processing paths of production code.; Validate User Input at Entry Point — Inapplicable to these changes because CLI/stdin entry-point parsing and validation logic are not modified.
